title: Templates: interpolation, property binding and event binding

videos.script:
A template is HTML with holes in it. Today you learn the four ways a hole connects to its class. {{bench}} You build a bench first, a component that exists only for this lesson, so the planner stays clean while you experiment.

{{curly}} Double curly braces put a value into the page as text. Even a value that looks like HTML stays text, and that is a security feature, not an accident. {{square}} Square brackets set a property of an element. And you find out that a property and an attribute are two different things, with one famous difference: the value of a text field.

{{round}} Round brackets listen. A click, a key, a value typed into a field. Data goes into the page through square brackets and comes back through round ones.

{{checked}} Then you break the template on purpose, and the build tells you exactly where. It also lets one mistake through, and you see why.

{{planner}} Last, the planner. The week shows its two numbers and a progress bar, and a screen reader hears the bar by name. The bench goes in the bin.
